svg.text: ▸ Adjust U1 to 5.00 V BEFORE fitting U2. A 7805 + heatsink may be
substituted (≈0.7 W dissipation at 100 mA load).
▸ 5 V USB output port and revised power budget: SEE SHEET 3.
amber = ARDUINO pin name · inside the package = AVR port + DIP pin no.
1. Fan PWM per Intel 4-wire spec: 25 kHz, open-collector,
pulled up inside the fan. Q1 pulls it LOW. R7 optional.
2. Timer1 phase-correct, TOP = F_CPU/50000 (320 at 16 MHz).
3. SENSE is open-collector, 2 pulses/rev. R8/R9 pull it to +5 V;
R12/R13 protect the MCU pins. RPM = pulses/s × 30.
4. D1 is a REVERSE SHUNT. It conducts only if the supply goes in
backwards, and then F1 clears. No volt drop, no heat.
5. On reset Q1 is off → PWM line floats high → fans run at 100 %.
6. SW1 is an external car-type switch in the +12 V line.
7. SW2 optional: momentary button D4 to GND, hold 2 s to zero the
filter hour meter. Internal pull-up, so it may be omitted.
8. All resistors 1/4 W 5 %. C5/C9 within 10 mm of U2.
9. Program U2 in a DIP-socket Uno, then swap the chip over.
U2 pin 1 via R4 pull-up to +5 V
